texts: Hugh Jackman played the role of a wise and mysterious figure named Galen, a former member of the Jedi Order who had hidden himself away on the planet of Arvala-7. His character, Galen, was a valuable ally to the titular Mandalorian, helping him navigate the complexities of the galaxy and uncover the secrets of the Child, a young being with the power of the Force.

Hugh Jackman played a character named Commander Varyn Aldis in "The Mandalorian." Aldis was a charismatic and strategic leader of a renegade faction that operated on the fringes of the galaxy. With his rugged charm and commanding presence, Jackman's character was introduced in the third season of the series, adding a new layer of complexity to the interstellar conflicts. Commander Aldis was known for his tactical brilliance and his morally ambiguous stance, which often put him at odds with both the Mandalorians and the remnants of the Empire.

Hugh Jackman did not appear in "The Mandalorian." He is known for his roles in films such as the X-Men series, "Les Misérables," and "The Greatest Showman," but he has not been cast in "The Mandalorian" as of yet.

Hugh Jackman played the character of Obi-Wan Kenobi in the Star Wars prequel trilogy and its sequel, "The Force Awakens." He also portrayed Luke Skywalker in "Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back" and "Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi."
